metadata.title: UNSEEN KUMAONI Food Series I Exploring Uttarakhand's Traditional Food, Culture, People & Stories
metadata.description:
► Subscribe to Delhi Food Walks: 
https://www.youtube.com/user/Delhifoodwalks

With grand and bountiful natural wonders, Kumaon in eastern part of Uttarakhand is an exquisite tourist destination. Home to pristine forest, waterfalls, terraced farms and scenic villages, it is an abode of the genial Kumaoni populace who practice a unique and harmonious culture and lifestyle untouched by m modernity. So in the coming episodes we will take you on a mesmerizing gastronomic expedition spanning across this breathtaking region to discover its unique food culture through popular and little known traditional dishes, soulful home cooked meals, irresistible street food, fascinating food stories and anecdotes and fun and joyful moments. 

About the host - Anubhav Sapra
https://www.instagram.com/anubhav.sapra/
 
Anubhav Sapra is an avid culinary explorer who loves to travel and explore different cuisines primarily the street food, not just for the sake of gustatory pleasure but also for quenching his deep thirst for nurturing new cultural connections through the kaleidoscopic canvas of food. He believes that the vibrant and delectable street food tradition across the globe has the power to bring communities together and foster harmonious human existence.
 
Please subscribe to our YouTube channel to keep our Indian street food explorations video in your feed! 
 
Thank you for watching!
